title: The Novena to Mary, Undoer of Knots

steps.title: Sign of the Cross
steps.versicle: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.

steps.title: Novena Intention
steps.prompt: Entrust to Our Lady Undoer of Knots the knot you carry today, and let her untie it in God's time.

uwk_daily_prayer.text: O Mary, Undoer of Knots: as St. Irenaeus taught of old, the knot of Eve's disobedience was untied by thy obedience. Untie in me the knots of my confusion, my fears, and my sins; make straight in me the road to my Lord; and keep me in the peace of His grace until it is done. Amen.
uwk_daily_prayer.source: original (after St. Irenaeus, Against Heresies III, 22)

hail_mary.text:
Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee.
Blessed art thou among women,
and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus.
Holy Mary, Mother of God,
pray for us sinners,
now and at the hour of our death.
Amen.
hail_mary.latin:
Ave Maria, gratia plena, Dominus tecum.
Benedicta tu in mulieribus,
et benedictus fructus ventris tui, Iesus.
Sancta Maria, Mater Dei,
ora pro nobis peccatoribus,
nunc et in hora mortis nostrae.
Amen.

uwk_closing.text: Mary, Undoer of Knots, I leave my knot in thy hands. Pray for us now, and at the hour of our death. Amen.
uwk_closing.source: original (title reference; Hail Mary petition formula)

schedule_note.note: The nine days before the September 28 memorial of Mary, Undoer of Knots (a locally-observed memorial; some calendars mark September 27). The session is a single static session; the pack deliberately ships short original invocations with the title reference only — the famous full novena liturgy circulated for this devotion is copyrighted, so no part of it is reproduced.
